description: This Java class 'TenantApiUsageState' manages API usage state for tenants, including thresholds, feature enablement, and state checks based on tenant profile data.

classes.name: TenantApiUsageState
classes.description: Manages API usage state for tenant profiles, including thresholds and feature enablement, extending BaseApiUsageState.

methods.description: Constructor initializing with TenantProfile and ApiUsageState.
